about: Reference QR codes for tests/qr.test.js. Made outside the repo; none of these tools is a NodeSignal dependency.
Matrices: python-qrcode 8.2 in byte mode (the text as UTF-8 bytes, no ECI), its own version fit and its own automatic mask ("mask").
Cross-check: ZXing (@zxing/library 0.21.3, its float version check replaced by the Java integer one) gives the identical matrix when forced to the same mask, for every case and every sweep entry.

"ruleMask" is the mask ZXing picks automatically: the four ISO/IEC 18004 penalty rules scored on the finished symbol, format and version information included, with the quiet zone counted as light. "ruleSha256" is the SHA-256 of ZXing's symbol with that mask (rows joined by \n). python-qrcode scores a symbol whose format and version areas and dark module are still light, and only looks for 1:1:3:1:1 patterns wholly inside the symbol, so its "mask" can differ.
"capacity" is the most bytes each version holds at each level, found by fitting with python-qrcode and with segno 1.6.6 (they agree).
"sweep" fills every version at every level to exactly that capacity with the "fill" alphabet repeated, and records the SHA-256 of the matrix (rows joined by \n).

segno 1.6.6 was tried as the matrix reference and rejected: it writes a whole extra zero byte after the terminator when the bit stream is already on a byte boundary, which in byte mode is every time, so unless the symbol is full its padding runs 00 EC 11 EC .. instead of EC 11 EC .. The symbols decode, but they do not follow the spec's pad codeword rule.
